articles.title: Oil prices climb as traders assess Middle East developments
articles.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said Tuesday that naval mines had prevented three tankers attempting to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
articles.description: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

articles.title: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
articles.description: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.

articles.title: U.S. eyes refining muscle of Indian billionaire Ambani's Reliance as Rubio visits Jamnagar plant
articles.description: Rubio said the "extraordinary" refining capacity of Reliance could help India diversify its energy supplies, hinting at greater offtake of Venezuelan crude.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
articles.description: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

articles.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
articles.description: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. Browsers and software makers are rushing out fixes.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
articles.description: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

articles.title: Australian data center operator NextDC's shares plunge 40% after it slashes earnings forecast
articles.description: The company cited power supply delays at its Melbourne facility amid local community and stakeholder opposition for lowering earnings forecast.

articles.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
articles.description: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.

articles.title: Elice's huge stock swings show AI's spending boom is getting more investor scrutiny
articles.description: The AI boom is entering a more unforgiving phase, as investors question whether the billions poured into data centers will translate into sustainable profits.

articles.title: Japan exports post huge miss in September as growth slows to 16.7%
articles.description: Japan's imports grew 18.9%, also missing expectations of 19.6% from Reuters.

articles.title: Capital One's strong quarter and progressing Discover integration are rewarded on Wall Street
articles.description: Stronger net interest income and credit performance were the stars of the bank's earnings.

articles.title: Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
articles.description: The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.

articles.title: Netflix posts third-quarter earnings beat, but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance
articles.description: Wall Street and investors will be looking for Netflix to provide additional details about the company's strategy following recent organizational changes

articles.title: People Are Vibe Coding the Ads Out of Their Smart TVs: Here's How
articles.description: A viral Claude Code prompt lets Android TV owners switch off sponsored rows and tracking software and build their own home screens, with no root access and every change reversible.

articles.title: Boeing wins FAA approval for 737 Max 10 after years of delays as Duffy says certification process should be faster
articles.description: The 737 Max 10, the largest model in the family, was set to start flying in 2020, but increased scrutiny and other safety issues delayed its certification.

articles.title: OpenAI Buys Orchestra Bio to Put AI Agents in Charge of Drug Development Grunt Work
articles.description: The ChatGPT maker is folding Orchestra’s drug-program agents into Rosalind, its life sciences suite, betting AI can shave time off the decade-plus it takes to bring a medicine to patients.

articles.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
articles.description: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

articles.title: Obsessed with CoreWeave and the AI trade? You're missing out on some great stocks
articles.description: Today's earnings show there's a cohort of the market that can thrive outside of the data center buildout.

articles.title: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
articles.description: J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions project a 10% annual return for Bitcoin over 10 to 15 years, though the firm isn’t adding it to its main portfolio models.
